tray.closePromptMessage: Keep The Fool running in the system tray?
tray.closePromptDetail: Your answer is remembered. You can change it later in Settings → System.

incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: The Fool opened, but the local The Fool Core backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart The Fool.

incompleteInstallation.title: The Fool installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so The Fool Core cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest The Fool. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined The Fool Core.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest The Fool package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined The Fool components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: The Fool package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This The Fool package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: The Fool opened, but The Fool Core stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling The Fool may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: The Fool opened, but The Fool Core stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling The Fool may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: The Fool opened, but The Fool Core could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart The Fool.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: The Fool detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, The Fool will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: The Fool is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another The Fool startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart The Fool.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.
